name: Games draw with the carnival theme
instruction: Game code takes every colour and font from theme and canvasFont in src/carnival/theme.ts, never from its own hex colours or font strings.
relevant_when: A game's game.ts file under src/games/<game-id>/ that draws on a canvas, for example by setting ctx.fillStyle, ctx.strokeStyle or ctx.font.
context: AGENTS.md house rule 3: every game draws with the carnival's theme so every booth on the midway looks like it belongs. Colours, fonts and sizes come from theme and canvasFont.
scope_reason: Every colour and font a game uses appears as a literal or a theme reference in its own game.ts.

checklist.name: no-literal-colours
checklist.rule: The file contains no colour literals such as '#4fc3f7', 'rgb(...)', 'rgba(...)', 'hsl(...)' or CSS colour names like 'red' assigned to fillStyle, strokeStyle, shadowColor or a gradient stop. Colours come from theme.colors. Pass when every colour is a theme.colors reference or a variable derived from one.

checklist.name: no-literal-fonts
checklist.rule: Every value assigned to ctx.font comes from canvasFont(...) or theme.font, not from a hand-written font string such as 'bold 20px sans-serif'. Not applicable when the file never sets ctx.font.
